title_en: New Slang, New Stories (2/20): How a Group Project Turned into Involution
note_en: 反而 (fǎn'ér) signals that the result is the opposite of what you'd expect: 谁做得太多，反而要扣分 "anyone who does too much will actually lose points." English uses "actually," "instead," or "if anything" here, but 反而 always comes right before the verb, never at the start of the sentence.
